descriptions.startup: A softly breathing orb stays at the center while nearby colored particles continuously arc inward at staggered intervals.
descriptions.startupResolved: The gathered orb expands softly and dissolves into Aide, settling naturally into the complete Idle pose.
descriptions.idle: After regular breathing and blinking, prolonged inactivity mixes glances, stretches, hops, dozing, tilts, and sways like a game character's idle behavior.
descriptions.context-summary: Three earlier conversation fragments follow an arc and compress into one summary card as Aide tracks the progress; the character stays steady so this reads differently from reasoning over the user's request.
descriptions.thinking: The silhouette flows slowly while a classic thought bubble gently breathes overhead and the gaze stays focused upward.
descriptions.thinkingResolved: The thought bubble retracts along its bubble trail, forming a light bulb that pops in and softly illuminates.
descriptions.web-search: The gaze scans horizontally while varied skeleton rows load down the computer screen.
descriptions.webSearchError: When a web tool fails, the computer remains visible and its screen shows a red warning triangle; Aide does not enter the global red X-eye error pose.
descriptions.visual-capture: A floating viewfinder scans the current picture, its four corners breathe inward, and a restrained shutter flash confirms the AI capture.
descriptions.data-chart: A compact chart panel rises beside Aide as bars breathe through new values and a trend line traces across the data.
descriptions.file-create: A blank page settles into place as its lines are written from top to bottom and a plus badge marks the new artifact.
descriptions.file-read: A scanning highlight travels down the page with a magnifier while Aide's gaze follows the current line.
descriptions.file-edit: A pencil revises one line across the page and leaves the changed text highlighted as Aide follows the stroke.
descriptions.dictionary: The eyes read line by line as a page lifts from the right, turns edge-on, and lands on the left.
descriptions.translate: English and Chinese speech bubbles trade a gentle lift while bidirectional arrows move between the languages.
descriptions.calculate: The gaze jumps between values as keys respond and numbers and operators keep popping outward in a continuous staggered stream.
descriptions.time: The eyes follow the clock, its hand rotates continuously, and a ripple travels around the edge.
descriptions.complete: The eyes arc upward as a ribbon trails Aide's Y-axis turn into green; the check pops only after landing.
descriptions.error: The eyes become X marks as the body recoils and turns red; sliced offsets and a scanning flicker settle, then return as a restrained low-frequency pulse while the error remains unresolved.
